item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "dd82840a505303692423572d82c2f5cefd08245594d1491e44b4cc65d67293c8",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "Defines q(x,t) = profile(x - speed*t) • eigenvector, with scalar multiplication applied coordinatewise.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specifies the vector-valued function whose two partial derivatives must exist and satisfy the equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "An abbreviation for LocalDef003 with index type Fin m.",
      "effect_on_target": "The conclusion is precisely the derivative-and-equation predicate in D003, with no additional conditions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "There exist vectors qt and qx such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative qt at t, ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) has derivative qx at x, and qt + coefficient*qx = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires both partial derivatives at the specified point and their simultaneous satisfaction of a homogeneous linear equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "Evaluates a profile at x - speed*t.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the argument of the scalar profile in q and in the differentiability hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "Real scalar multiplication on real-valued functions on any index type is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of scalar multiplication for the vector-valued derivative predicate; it is established infrastructure, not an extra hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "Algebra.id",
      "meaning": "Makes a commutative semiring an algebra over itself using the identity map and multiplication as scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Real scalars act on real coordinates by ordinary multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "Algebra.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication operation from an algebra structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real scalar action used in the eigenvector equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "CommSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains the semiring structure of a commutative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies ordinary real semiring operations to the self-algebra construction without changing their meaning.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "ContinuousMul.to_continuousSMul",
      "meaning": "Continuous multiplication gives jointly continuous scalar multiplication when the action is multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of the real self-action needed for scalar differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "A densely normed field carries a nontrivial normed-field structure with the same field and norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the required scalar-field structure for differentiation over the reals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both Av = speed*v and qt + A*qx = 0 are exact vector equalities, hence coordinatewise equalities.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin m is the finite index type of natural numbers i with 0 ≤ i < m.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vectors have m real coordinates and matrices have m rows and m columns, including the empty case m = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Enumerates all indices in Fin m.",
      "effect_on_target": "Matrix-vector multiplication sums over every index from 0 through m - 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Function.hasSMul",
      "meaning": "Lifts a scalar action to functions by acting on their values.",
      "effect_on_target": "Scalar multiplication of vectors is coordinatewise.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "HMul.hMul",
      "meaning": "Selects the multiplication operation from the specified multiplication instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "The product speed*t is ordinary real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Selects the scalar multiplication operation from the specified action instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets speed • eigenvector and profile(x - speed*t) • eigenvector as real scalar multiples.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Selects subtraction from the specified subtraction instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "The profile argument is the real difference x - speed*t.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "States that a function of one scalar variable has the specified derivative at a point, using its full neighborhood and fixing the base point.",
      "effect_on_target": "The hypothesis is ordinary real differentiability at x - speed*t; the conclusion requires ordinary vector-valued derivatives of the two coordinate slices at t and x.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring",
      "meaning": "A topological ring has the corresponding topological-semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Transfers continuity of real arithmetic to the structures supporting differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "IsTopologicalSemiring.toContinuousMul",
      "meaning": "Multiplication in a topological semiring is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides continuous real multiplication and thereby continuous real scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "Matrix",
      "meaning": "A matrix is a function taking a row index and a column index to an entry.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coefficient is an arbitrary array A(i,j) of real numbers indexed by Fin m × Fin m.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "Matrix.mulVec",
      "meaning": "Matrix-vector multiplication takes the dot product of each matrix row with the vector: (Av)i = Σj A(i,j)vj.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the row-by-column orientation of both the eigenvector relation and the equation involving qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers, including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "The dimension m is any nonnegative integer.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the nonunital, nonassociative commutative-ring structure of a nonunital commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Passes unchanged real operations toward the structure required for matrix-vector multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital, nonassociative ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real addition and multiplication in the matrix multiplication instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, multiplication, zero, and distributivity while forgetting additive inverses.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real semiring operations used to form row dot products.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital commutative-ring structure from a normed one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects real normed arithmetic to the algebraic operations in matrix-vector multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital seminormed-ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real norm and operations used to support the derivative codomain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the additive group, norm, and pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive and norm structure of the real derivative codomain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts a normed-field structure from a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real field and norm used throughout differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains normed commutative-ring operations while forgetting the unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the same real addition and multiplication for matrix-vector products.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Views a normed commutative ring as a seminormed commutative ring with the same operations, norm, and pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies compatible real norm and topology structures for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed commutative-ring structure of a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real normed field to the real arithmetic and topology instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A normed field is a normed vector space over itself, with multiplication as scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "The scalar profile derivative is taken in the ordinary real vector space R.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure of a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real linear operations required by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects real distance to the neighborhood topology used for derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "All coordinates, entries, independent variables, the speed, and the profile derivative value are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Equips the reals with their densely normed-field structure based on Real.normedField.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the scalar domain supports the stated derivative notion without an additional field hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative-group structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary addition and additive inverses for real derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "Real.instCommSemiring",
      "meaning": "The commutative-semiring structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the self-algebra whose scalar action is real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "Real multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines speed*t and scalar products of real coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "Real.instSub",
      "meaning": "Real subtraction, defined by adding the negative of the second operand.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the sign in x - speed*t.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The real commutative ring with its standard norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies compatible real arithmetic for matrix products and normed structures for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field equipped with its standard norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes ordinary real calculus as the interpretation of the derivative assertions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real distance is dist(x,y) = |x - y|.",
      "effect_on_target": "Derivative limits use the usual real topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the operations, norm, and pseudometric of a seminormed commutative ring while forgetting its unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the standard real additive and norm structures used by the derivative predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the seminormed-ring structure from a seminormed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the same real pseudometric through the normed-structure hierarchy.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric structure of a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real metric topology used in continuity and differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology associated with a uniform structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the neighborhoods entering the derivative assertions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "instHMul",
      "meaning": "Exposes an ordinary multiplication operation through heterogeneous multiplication notation.",
      "effect_on_target": "The multiplication notation in speed*t uses the supplied real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "instHSMul",
      "meaning": "Exposes an existing scalar action through heterogeneous scalar multiplication notation.",
      "effect_on_target": "The displayed scalar-vector products use the coordinatewise real action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "instHSub",
      "meaning": "Exposes ordinary subtraction through heterogeneous subtraction notation.",
      "effect_on_target": "The subtraction notation in the profile argument uses real subtraction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "instIsTopologicalRingReal",
      "meaning": "The reals form a topological ring under their usual topology and arithmetic.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of the arithmetic used by real scalar differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both derivative assertions and the vector equation must hold for the same witnesses.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure of a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real semiring operations within the vector module infrastructure without imposing a nonzero-vector condition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over an object satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "The conclusion quantifies first qt and then qx; both witnesses may depend on the preceding data and hypotheses.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains the semifield structure of a field, preserving addition, multiplication, and division.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies underlying real scalar algebra; no division or nonvanishing assumption is added to the mathematical claim.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Fintype",
      "meaning": "A finite enumeration containing every element of an index type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the matrix row sums are finite; the target obtains this structure from Fin m.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Selects addition from the specified addition instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "The equation adds the vectors qt and coefficient*qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative-monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real addition and zero for finite sums and vector module structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains nonunital semiring operations while forgetting the associativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real operations in the algebraic structure chain supporting the conclusion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the field structure of a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real scalar algebra beneath the vector derivative structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral in a type using its numeral instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the numeral 0 in the vector equation as the zero vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "Functions into a module form a module under pointwise addition and scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fin m → Real is the real vector space in which qt and qx take values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "Pi.addCommGroup",
      "meaning": "A family of additive commutative groups gives a pointwise additive commutative group of functions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector-valued differentiation uses the ordinary coordinatewise additive group on R^m.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Pi.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Function addition is defined by (f + g)(i) = f(i) + g(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "The final vector equation is a separate scalar equation in every coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "Pi.instZero",
      "meaning": "The zero function has value zero at every index.",
      "effect_on_target": "The right side of qt + coefficient*qx = 0 has every coordinate equal to real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "Pi.topologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Functions carry the product topology induced by coordinate evaluations.",
      "effect_on_target": "The vector derivative limits use the finite product topology on R^m, equivalently coordinatewise convergence.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Real addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines coordinatewise vector addition and the scalar sums in the equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "Real.instRing",
      "meaning": "The ring structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies ordinary real ring operations to the algebraic infrastructure of the conclusion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The real number zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the coordinate values of the zero vector in the equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "Ring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts a ring's semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the same real addition and multiplication to the module and summation infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the division-semiring structure of a semifield.",
      "effect_on_target": "Passes real scalar operations through the typeclass hierarchy without adding a condition to the proposition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital semiring structure, preserving addition, multiplication, and zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies unchanged real algebra for the structures underlying the conclusion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 0 as the zero supplied by a Zero instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the equation's literal 0 the coordinatewise zero vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Exposes ordinary addition through heterogeneous addition notation.",
      "effect_on_target": "The displayed addition in the equation uses pointwise vector addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts an additive-monoid structure from an additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive structure used by the real scalar action on vectors, with unchanged operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "ContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "Joint continuity of the scalar action as a function of scalar and vector.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the topological vector-space derivative notion; its instances are supplied, not separately assumed of the input data.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative action from an action that distributes over addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains the same scalar action used on the real vector space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action of a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the vector module structure to its coordinatewise scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "Monoid.toSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts a monoid's associative multiplication structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies underlying real scalar multiplication for the action hierarchy.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative monoid of a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports real scalar actions while retaining all real scalars, including zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "MulAction.toSemigroupAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts a semigroup action from a monoid action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real scalar action through the action hierarchy.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "Pi.instSMul",
      "meaning": "Defines function scalar multiplication by (a • f)(i) = a • f(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "Confirms that every coordinate of q is profile(x - speed*t) times the corresponding vector coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "SemigroupAction.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication operation from a semigroup action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the same scalar operation used in the vector-valued derivative structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Retains a semiring's multiplication, identity, zero, and their laws as a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the multiplicative real scalar structure for the module action without restricting scalar values.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "For every natural number m, including m = 0.",
      "For every real m × m matrix A = coefficient, indexed by i,j ∈ Fin m.",
      "For every function f = profile : R → R.",
      "For every real number d = profile' and every real number c = speed.",
      "For every vector v = eigenvector ∈ R^m, represented by a function Fin m → R.",
      "For every pair of real numbers x and t."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "Av = cv: for every i ∈ Fin m, Σ(j ∈ Fin m) A(i,j)v(j) = c v(i).",
      "The scalar function f has ordinary real derivative d at the point x - ct."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
